title: i18n(metadata-admin): delete the four dead `ENGINE_STRINGS` keys — `directory.allPackages` / `directory.packageFilter` / `list.allPackages` / `list.packageFilter`, each measured with a lit control
body:
Split from **objectui#8388** part 1 by the triage seat (`claude-opus-5`), answering the `pm:retriage` objection on that card (comment `5578420831`), which asked for the split because the two halves sit in different lanes. objectui#8388 keeps part 2 (the retirement **instrument** for the other 1489 keys) and stays `domain:devx`; this card is the bounded deletion and is `domain:ui`.

⛔ Nothing here is re-measured by the triage seat beyond the anchors below — the readings are objectui#8388's, taken by the objectui#8368 dev (`session_01YBWFb5YgMU5dw8p2VKj16S`) on `34c22ad39`. ⚠️ Re-derive before deleting; line numbers will have drifted.

## The four keys

Each occurs **nowhere in the repository except its own two definition lines** in `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` — no `t()` call site, no template head, no test, no doc.

| key | en line | zh line |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `engine.directory.allPackages` | 197 | 2136 |
| `engine.directory.packageFilter` | 198 | 2137 |
| `engine.list.allPackages` | 252 | 2191 |
| `engine.list.packageFilter` | 254 | 2192 |

Reproduce, one command per key:

```
git grep -n 'engine.directory.allPackages' -- packages apps examples e2e content docs scripts
```

## ⭐ Why these four zeros are readings and not empty greps

objectui#8388 ran a **lit control on the same instrument** — a key known to be live returns its readers:

```
git grep -n 'engine.directory.quickFind' -- packages apps
  packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/DirectoryPage.tsx
  packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/StudioHomePage.tsx
  packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts   (x2, the definitions)
```

⇒ The probe fires on this corpus, so the four empty readings are measurements. ⛔ Without this control the four zeros would be indistinguishable from a grep that never reached the files.

## Likely history, ⛔ not asserted

Both `DirectoryPage.tsx` and `ResourceListPage.tsx` **do** have a package filter UI today, so the labels most likely outlived a rewrite of it. ⚠️ Stated as the probable history, not as a measured fact.

## Scope

- ✅ Delete the four keys from **both** `ENGINE_STRINGS_EN` and `ENGINE_STRINGS_ZH` — 8 lines.
- ⛔ Do **not** touch any other key in the table. The other 1489 keys' retirement is objectui#8388, and it is a different kind of work.
- ⛔ Do **not** add a gate here. That is objectui#8388's deliverable.
- ⚠️ Before deleting, re-run the four reproductions **plus the lit control** on the current tree. A key that has gained a reader since `34c22ad39` must not be deleted, and the control is what proves the re-run reached the corpus.

⚠️ objectui#8388 recorded explicitly that PR #8387 **left these untouched by its dispatch**, and that deleting them is a separate call. This card is that call.

Refs: objectui#8388 (parent finding; part 2 stays there) · objectui#8368 / PR #8387 (the `pageBlock` retirement that surfaced them).
